entries.qualifier: average across multiple devices; below 0.1 µeV·Hz^-1/2 under some operating conditions
entries.note: Peer-reviewed demonstration that Quantum Motion's customized 300 mm Si MOS line yields uniform, record-low-noise quantum dots. Reviewed but company-performed — sits at peer_review, not higher.

entries.qualifier: full-stack silicon-CMOS system physically installed at NQCC under the testbed programme
entries.note: The delivery is corroborated by NQCC and independent press. It proves installation of a full-stack 300 mm CMOS system at an independent evaluator — it does NOT yet prove any performance figure for that system.

entries.qualifier: T1 > 1 s at 1 T; T2* > 3 ms; quantum dots from all-optical-lithography 300 mm industrial processing (Si/SiGe)
entries.note: Architecture-level evidence that industrial 300 mm processing can host coherent spin qubits — performed by QuTech/Intel, not Quantum Motion. Supports the modality thesis, not the company.

entries.qualifier: dual-rail SPAM 99.98%±0.01; HOM visibility 99.50%±0.25; two-qubit fusion 99.22%±0.12; chip-to-chip interconnect 99.72%±0.04 — all conditional on photon detection, NOT accounting for loss
entries.note: Peer-reviewed component benchmarks from a complete manufacturable platform. The 'conditional on detection' qualifier is load-bearing: the unresolved question is total system loss, not component fidelity.

entries.qualifier: Omega manufactured in GlobalFoundries' high-volume NY fab; ~500k device-level measurements per month claimed; millions of devices, thousands of wafers tested
entries.note: Manufacturing-throughput claims are company disclosure; foundry partnership is corroborated by the Nature paper's industrial provenance.

entries.qualifier: largest quantum cryogenic module installed and under test at DOE's SLAC laboratory (per company account)
entries.note: Government-lab hosting of hardware under test — but the only captured source is PsiQuantum's own release, so this sits at technical_disclosure, not independent_testbed. A DOE/SLAC confirmation would promote it.

entries.qualifier: 3-rack data-centre footprint, Qiskit/Cirq-compatible interface, 300 mm silicon CMOS QPU
entries.note: Company-specified system description. The delivery fact is independently corroborated (ev-qm-nqcc-installed-2025); the performance envelope inside the racks is not.
